note: Hand-curated. This file exists because a model answering from memory assumes a vanilla WoW admin panel is read-only web pages, and narrows every answer it gives to fit that assumption. Each entry below is a real road in or out of this app. Edit it freely - it is meant to be maintained by hand, and every entry should be checkable by hitting its route.

capabilities.title: Read any file out of the client archives
capabilities.what: Fully managed MPQ v1 reader mounts the vanilla archives and extracts any path (models, textures, DBCs, FrameXML). Native StormLib and War3Net are both gone.
capabilities.caveat: Live patches (patch-4/patch-5) are read from private scratch COPIES and never held open. AdtTerrainReader does its own per-call open because it reads patch-Z, which MpqReaderService deliberately skips.

capabilities.title: Decode BLP textures to PNG
capabilities.what: Managed BLP decoder, used for icons, item textures and terrain layers.

capabilities.title: Serve any client icon by name
capabilities.what: Sanitizes a name, extracts Interface\Icons\{name}.blp straight from the MPQ, decodes it and returns PNG.
capabilities.caveat: 404 on any miss by design - no disk fallback and no questionmark substitution, so a broken path stays visible instead of being masked.

capabilities.title: Read client DBC data
capabilities.what: DBC tables straight out of the archives: item display info, spell visuals, icon paths and the rest of the client-side reference data.

capabilities.title: Query the 1.12 UI catalog
capabilities.what: 233 virtual templates, 3280 named frames, 379 texture paths, 35 font objects, 1265 Lua functions, 6060 Lua globals and 1954 XML->Lua bindings, harvested from the real FrameXML. Every record carries file and line, so answers are citable rather than recalled.
capabilities.caveat: Regenerated offline by framexml_index.py + framexml_split.py into wwwroot/data/framexml. Re-run after any FrameXML change; the harvester reports parse errors.

capabilities.title: Read the documented VMaNGOS core
capabilities.what: A folder-mirrored Markdown corpus, one page per C++ unit, cross-linked Unit/Member, with a machine-true MAP table per page. Full-text searchable through the docs_* index the app provisions itself.

capabilities.title: Query the C++ source index directly
capabilities.what: Live symbol/callgraph index over the core source, plus a research bundle per database column.

capabilities.title: Query the game databases
capabilities.what: Full schema for 255 tables with 749 curated foreign-key edges, so a question like 'what points at this creature' is answerable without guessing at joins.

capabilities.title: Write game data
capabilities.what: Items, loot, spells, game objects and instance loot are edited through their own pages, not just read.

capabilities.title: Generate and commit new item textures
capabilities.what: Seeded palette-swap recolor with theory/tier/value knobs, applied to a selection or drained from a queue, minting new display ids and writing them into the retexture tables.
capabilities.caveat: Every re-run used to mint a fresh display id while orphaning the previous one. Use the source-scoped revert, and PurgeOrphans for debris.

capabilities.title: Build and hand over a client patch archive
capabilities.what: Rebuilds patch-4.MPQ from the retexture tables and serves it for download.
capabilities.caveat: The WSL folder the rebuild auto-copies to is NOT what the game reads. Deploying to the real client is still a manual copy into C:\WoW Vanilla\Data\.

capabilities.title: Read and write terrain
capabilities.what: Parses ADT terrain (MCNK/MODF/MDDF/MCVT/MCLY/MCAL) and VMaNGOS .map heightmaps, renders them in 3D, and writes ADTs back out.

capabilities.title: Render a character or item in 3D
capabilities.what: Reads M2 models out of the MPQ, composites the character skin, and emits a skinned GLB the browser renders - so an item can be previewed on a real model rather than as a flat icon.

capabilities.title: Drive the running server
capabilities.what: Console commands, player and account administration, realm state, config editing and backups against the live realm.

capabilities.title: Command the bot fleet
capabilities.what: Fleet state, per-bot control, live map positions and the chat personality/capacity settings for the AiBot population.
